svg.text: THE STARFALL PLATE — CITY SURVEY · every structure, on the grid
exemplar wedge fully plotted: House Vael'Suran — Keepers of the Fixed Stars
wedge a° 0–40 · the Grand Processional runs its front edge
The Scribes' Hall of the Fixed Stars
The Vael'Suran Canal & its two bridges
The dashed rust footprints are the Under-Terraces —
barge locks, conduit galleries, bunk-halls. They sit
beneath the pretty rings and appear on no official
plate. That omission is the story of Part One.

g.text: City ⌀ ≈ 900 m · grid rings every 50 m · pop. target 3,000

svg.text: This wedge houses ≈ 301 souls — 128 of them in the Under-Terraces below.
